articles.title: Kulgam Encounter: One Terrorist Killed, Another Trapped After CRPF Attack
articles.description: One terrorist has been killed and another remains trapped in an encounter with security forces in Jammu and Kashmir's Kulgam district. The encounter follows intelligence inputs about terrorists linked to the November 11 attack on a CRPF checkpoint in Akhran, where three personnel were injured. The terrorists have been identified as Lateef Bhatt and Umar. Security forces are continuing efforts to track down the second terrorist.
